title: Corporate Glass Tower
tagline: High-performance structural glass curtain wall corporate headquarters
description: An imposing commercial office building designed for corporate and financial clients in Ambikapur. Highlights include a full-height double-glazed reflective curtain wall, contrasting horizontal louvre fins, and generous ground-floor customer banking lobby.

details.Key Elements: Curtain Wall Glazing, Shading Louvres, Ground Retail, Corporate Executive Suites
